name: @la/server
description: The composition root (ADR §2). The ONLY package permitted to depend on @la/lang-* packages (ADR §2.4 rule a): composeApp — pure DI, no container — with the literal-import registry, the contractVersion equality assert, the manifest parse, deriveCapabilities, and asset existence + spine-schema boot validation.
